parameters.NI: <int> Number of distinct items to be produced.
parameters.NK: <int> Number of machines available for production.
parameters.NT: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.

costs.setup_cost_f: <int> Fixed cost incurred each period a machine is set up for any item, uniform across all items and machines.
costs.startup_cost_g: <int> Fixed cost incurred each time a machine starts up for an item it was not set up for in the previous period, uniform across all items and machines.
costs.holding_cost_h: <list[int], length NI> Per-unit cost of holding one unit of each item in inventory at the end of a period.
costs.backlogging_cost_e: <list[int], length NI> Per-unit penalty cost for each unit of unmet demand (backlog) for each item at the end of a period.

machine_data.capacity_C: <list[int], length NK> Maximum production quantity each machine can produce in any single period.
machine_data.startup_time_sigma: <list[int], length NK> Amount of production capacity consumed on each machine when a startup occurs in a period.

demand: <list[list[int]], shape [NI][NT]> Quantity of each item required by customers in each period.

initial_conditions.initial_stock_s0: <list[int], length NI> Inventory on hand for each item at the start of the planning horizon.
initial_conditions.initial_backlog_r0: <list[int], length NI> Unfulfilled demand for each item carried into the start of the planning horizon.
